name: Mention
summary: A field with a list of people under it. The reader types, the host decides which names to offer, and each name is a button that carries an avatar slot and an @name.
summaryZh: 一个输入框,底下压着一份人的名单。读者打字,由使用方决定端出哪些名字,每个名字是一个按钮,带着一个头像位和一个 @名字。

variants.name: Bordered
variants.note: The field is a box with a border. The base class on its own is already this.

variants.name: Plain
variants.note: The field drops its border and its fill, so it reads as a line of text on the page.

variants.name: Round
variants.note: The field is a pill, for a mention that sits at the end of a sentence.

sizes.name: Medium
sizes.note: The default field needs no modifier class.

states.name: Focus visible
states.note: The ring is drawn around the field, because the field is what the reader is typing in — the input is inside it, not beside it.

states.name: Disabled
states.note: The field paints the flat control surface and takes the derived disabled colour.

states.name: Clearable
states.note: The field carries a button that empties it.

states.name: Loading
states.note: The field says it is busy: the mark appears and the names wait.

states.name: Show arrow
states.note: The field carries the arrow that says a list is behind it.

parts.name: Field
parts.note: The box the input sits in. It owns the field's fill and border, so the input inside it paints none.

parts.name: Input
parts.note: The real text input. It is borderless, so the field and the text read as one control.

parts.name: List
parts.note: The panel of names. It sits on the overlay surface and carries its own shadow.

parts.name: Item
parts.note: One name in the list. It is a real button, so it is focusable and can be pressed with the keyboard.

parts.name: Avatar
parts.note: The avatar slot in front of the name. It is a disc the host fills with initials.

parts.name: Name
parts.note: The name itself, written with the @ in front of it, the way the reader will see it in the text.

parts.name: Prefix
parts.note: The character that starts a mention. It is written in front of the text, the way the reader will see it in the sentence.

parts.name: Header
parts.note: The line above the list of names.

parts.name: Footer
parts.note: The line below the list of names.

parts.name: Loading
parts.note: The mark that says the names are on their way. It is drawn, and the caller may write its own instead.

parts.name: Clear
parts.note: The button that empties the field. It is a real button, and its mark is drawn from two bars.

parts.name: Arrow
parts.note: The chevron that says a list is behind the field. It is drawn from two borders.

props.name: size
props.description: The height of the field and the size of its type.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The hint in the empty field.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the field. It becomes the input's aria-label.
props.descriptionZh: 输入框的可访问名称,它会变成 input 的 aria-label。

props.name: model-value
props.description: The text in the field, bound with v-model in Vue. Leave it out and the `value` prop is the text; bind it and the field answers to the binding.
props.descriptionZh: 输入框里的文字,在 Vue 里用 v-model 绑定。不传就以 value 属性为准;传了就以绑定为准。

props.name: disabled
props.description: Makes the field inert. It uses the real disabled attribute on the input, so it leaves the tab order and the field paints the flat control surface.
props.descriptionZh: 让输入框不可用。它用的是 input 上的原生 disabled 属性,因此会退出 Tab 顺序,字段也会铺上扁平的控件底色。

props.name: readonly
props.description: Keeps the text visible but stops it being edited. It is the native readonly attribute, so the browser refuses the edit. The library does not repaint a read-only field — it is not a state it measures.
props.descriptionZh: 文字仍然可见,但不能编辑。它是原生 readonly 属性,浏览器会拒绝编辑。库不会给只读字段单独配色 —— 这不是它测量过的状态。

props.name: clearable
props.description: Puts a button at the end of the field that empties it. The button is a real one, so it is in the tab order.
props.descriptionZh: 在输入框末尾放一个按钮,按它就把输入框清空。这个按钮是真的,所以它在 Tab 顺序里。

props.name: loading
props.description: Says the names are on their way. The mark appears in the field; the names themselves are the host's to bring.
props.descriptionZh: 表示名字正在路上。输入框里会出现那个标记;名单本身归宿主端上来。

props.name: prefix
props.description: The character that starts a mention. It is written in the field, the way the reader will see it in the sentence.
props.descriptionZh: 开始一次提及的那个字符。它写在输入框里,就像读者在句子里会看到的那样。

props.name: show-arrow
props.description: Puts the chevron at the end of the field, so the field says a list is behind it. The list here is a panel on the page, but it opens and closes with the field, so the arrow says what the reader cannot see.
props.descriptionZh: 在输入框末尾放上那个小箭头,让输入框表明背后有一份名单。这里的名单是页面上的一个面板,但它跟着输入框开关,所以这个箭头说的正是读者看不见的那件事。

props.name: type
props.description: The kind of field the input is. It is the input's own type attribute, so the browser brings its own keyboard and its own validation with it.
props.descriptionZh: 输入框是哪一种字段。它是 input 自己的 type 属性,所以浏览器会带上它自己的键盘和校验。

props.name: form
props.description: The id of the form the field belongs to. It is the input's own form attribute, so a field may live outside its form and still be submitted with it.
props.descriptionZh: 这个输入框属于哪个表单。它是 input 自己的 form 属性,所以输入框可以放在表单外面,仍然跟着那个表单一起提交。

slots.name: default
slots.description: The names in the list. Each one is a list item holding a button.
slots.descriptionZh: 列表里的名字,每个名字是一个列表项,里面放一个按钮。

slots.name: header
slots.description: The line above the list of names.

slots.name: footer
slots.description: The line below the list of names.

slots.name: label
slots.description: The name of one mention. The wrapper writes three names of its own when the caller has not written any, and this slot is what fills them; the caller's own names carry their own words.
slots.descriptionZh: 一个提及的名字。调用方没有自己写名单时,包装组件会写三个,这个插槽就是填它们的;调用方自己写的名字,文字也由调用方自己写。

slots.name: loading
slots.description: The mark that says the names are on their way. It is drawn when the slot is empty and the caller's own when it is not.
slots.descriptionZh: 表示名字正在路上的那个标记。插槽为空时是画出来的,调用方写了自己的就是调用方的。

events.name: input
events.description: Fires when the text in the field changes.
events.descriptionZh: 输入框里的文字变了就触发。

events.name: update:modelValue
events.description: Fires when the value changes, carrying the new value. This is the event `v-model` listens to.
events.descriptionZh: 值变化时触发,携带新的值。v-model 监听的就是这个事件。

events.name: search
events.description: Fires on every keystroke in the field, carrying what has been typed. It is the same moment as the input event, under the name the mention gives it: the host is looking for names.
events.descriptionZh: 在输入框里每敲一个字就触发,携带打进去的字。它和 input 事件是同一个时刻,只是用了提及给它的名字:宿主正在找人。

events.name: select
events.description: Fires when one of the names is chosen, carrying the name. The wrapper reports it for the names it writes itself; a name the caller wrote is the caller's own button, so the caller wires it.
events.descriptionZh: 选中一个名字时触发,携带那个名字。包装组件只报告它自己写的那些名字;调用方自己写的名字是调用方自己的按钮,归调用方自己接。

events.name: clear
events.description: Fires when the reader presses the clear button. The value goes with it, so the field is empty afterwards.
events.descriptionZh: 读者按下清空按钮时触发。值也跟着清掉,所以按下之后输入框是空的。

a11y.notes: The field is a real text input, so the keyboard, the autofill and the screen reader all behave the way the reader expects. The names in the list are real buttons, so each one can be reached with the keyboard and pressed with Space — the library installs no listener and asks for no script. Give the input an accessible name: an aria-label, or a visible label above it. The list is not a listbox here: nothing tracks which name is active, so it is an ordinary list of buttons, and the reader reaches them by tabbing.
a11y.notesZh: 输入框是真的文本输入,键盘、自动填充和读屏都会按读者熟悉的方式工作。列表里的名字是真按钮,每一个都能用键盘走到、按空格选中 —— 库里没有装任何监听器,也不需要脚本。给输入框一个可访问的名字:aria-label,或者上面写一个看得见的标签。这里的列表不是 listbox:没有东西在跟踪当前选中的是谁,所以它就是一份普通的按钮列表,读者靠 Tab 一个个走到。

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: A field and the names under it. Each name is a button with an avatar slot in front of it.
examples.descriptionZh: 一个输入框和底下的名单。每个名字是一个按钮,前面带一个头像位。

examples.title: Variants
examples.description: Three shapes for the field. The bordered one is the base class on its own, because the base class is already the bordered field.
examples.descriptionZh: 输入框的三种形态。描边的那种只写基础类,因为基础类本来就是描边的输入框。

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: Three heights. The middle one is the base class on its own, because the base class is already the medium field.
examples.descriptionZh: 三种高度。中间那个只写基础类,因为基础类本来就是中号输入框。

notes: Element Plus opens the list when the reader types an @ and closes it when they stop; here the list is a container and the host decides whether it is on the page. The input is a real input inside a borderless field, so the field and the text read as one control rather than as a field with something stuck to it. The field paints the surface and the input paints none — two translucent layers would be a colour no role names.
notesZh: Element Plus 是读者打出 @ 时打开名单、停下来时又收走;这里的名单就是一个容器,在不在页面上由使用方决定。输入是真的 input,放在一个没有边框的外壳里,所以外壳和文字读起来是一个控件,而不是一个框上粘了个什么东西。外壳负责画底色,input 什么都不画 —— 两层半透明叠起来就是一个谁都没命名的颜色。
